verses.mystical_translation: The the Living Presence is my light and my deliverance and wholeness; whom shall I fear? the the Living Presence is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.

One thing have I desired of the the Living Presence, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the the Living Presence all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the the Living Presence, and to enquire in his sanctuary.
For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

Hear, O the Living Presence, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
When you saidst, Seek you my face; my heart said to you, Your face, the Living Presence, will I seek.
Hide not your face far from me; put not your servant away in anger: you have been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O the Divine of my deliverance and wholeness.
When my father and my mother forsake me, then the the Living Presence will take me up.

I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the the Living Presence in the land of the living.
Wait on the the Living Presence: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart: wait, I say, on the the Living Presence.

contemplative_note: Courage can be the practice of seeking beauty while danger is still present.
safety_note: The psalm does not guarantee family acceptance, military victory, or immediate rescue; people abandoned by family deserve concrete human support as well as spiritual comfort.
